summary.headline: Every registered pipeline can produce a STABLE PARTIAL logical PipelineKey from already-banked contracts. Authoritative today: depthState, cullMode, blend factor, color-attachment mask, renderPassCompat. Descriptive/not-yet-authoritative: shaderVariantId (no repo-owned enum â€” only runtime glProgramName + the informal unique_name_suffix_), specializationParams, materialLayout (per-pipeline mapping), rasterState polygonOffset/depthBias (unregistered-pass consumers). vertexLayout is now AUTHORITATIVE (VERTEXLAYOUT-AUTHORITY-1); rasterState is PARTIAL — frontFace + cullMode authoritative (PIPELINEKEY-RASTERSTATE-FRONTFACE-AUTHORITY-1), polygonOffset/depthBias still a gap. Implementation (a real keyed cache) waits on SPIRV-CONSUMER-PILOT / OFFLINE-SHADER-VARIANT-BUILD.
summary.can_every_registered_pipeline_produce_a_: YES (partial â€” authoritative core + explicitly-listed gaps)

status_legend.AUTHORITATIVE: value is owned + checked by a banked contract; safe to key on now
status_legend.PARTIAL: core value authoritative but a sub-axis is missing (named in gaps)
status_legend.DESCRIPTIVE: value is derivable/documented but not yet a repo-owned stable id; do NOT key on yet
status_legend.MISSING: not modeled anywhere; must be added before a real PSO key

fields.source: SHADER-PERMUTATION-INVENTORY-1 (shader-permutation-inventory.json OFFLINE_VARIANT set) + runtime glProgramName + gosMaterialVariation.unique_name_suffix_ (gameos_graphics.cpp:356-357)
fields.note: Variant SPACE is finite/enumerable (inventory GO) but there is no repo-owned variant-id ENUM yet; glProgramName is a runtime GL name. Becomes authoritative when offline variants are baked + named.
Both numeric, typed, enumerable. Not consumed by the 4 registered raster pipelines directly (CSM rides the material/terrain path; READBACK is compute-cull).

fields.source: VERTEXLAYOUT-AUTHORITY-1: repo-owned RenderCore::VertexLayoutId enum (RenderCore/PipelineRegistry.h) with canonical layout-name comments; recorded at runtime via recordPipelineVertexLayout (gos_mech_batcher.cpp MechOpaque, gos_static_prop_batcher.cpp StaticProp*); cross-checked by scripts/check-pipeline-key.py against each pipeline's vertexLayoutId/vertexLayout. Underlying VAO setup: static-prop 40B (gos_static_prop_batcher.cpp:2310-2323), mech GpuMechVertex 48B (gos_mech_batcher.cpp:1376-1382)
fields.note: Promoted DESCRIPTIVE -> AUTHORITATIVE. Layouts form a fixed, finite, repo-owned id space (VertexLayoutId). Each registered pipeline declares a vertexLayoutId; the checker FAILS on a missing id, a stale/renamed enum value, or a vertexLayout string that disagrees with the enum's canonical name.
Checked by check-render-contract-gbuffer1 + the contract's own static_asserts.

descriptive_subaxes: per-pipeline descriptor-set grouping (which bindings belong to which pipeline is not yet a single owned record)
fields.note: The binding/sampler/material ABIs are individually banked + checked; assembling them into one per-pipeline descriptor-layout record is the descriptive gap.

gaps: blendEquation (only factor modeled; GL_FUNC_ADD assumed, set nowhere)
frontFace (winding not in PipelineDesc; only the save/restore snapshot tracks it)

fields.source: PIPELINEKEY-RASTERSTATE-FRONTFACE-AUTHORITY-1 (frontFace/cullMode) + SHADOW-CASTER-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1 (polygonOffsetEnable): PipelineDesc.{frontFace,cullMode,polygonOffsetEnable}. frontFace/cullMode applied by applyPipeline; polygonOffsetEnable is DESCRIPTIVE for the shadow rows (not applyPipeline-driven). Cross-checked by scripts/check-pipeline-key.py against each pipeline row.
authoritative_subaxes: polygonOffsetEnable (RenderCore PipelineDesc.polygonOffsetEnable bool, per-pipeline row, checked — ENABLE/DISABLE ONLY)
gaps: polygonOffset factor/units MAGNITUDE — intentionally EXCLUDED/DYNAMIC: runtime-mutable via ImGui (shadowBiasFactor_/Units_, gos_postprocess.h), the VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_BIAS analog; not a static key field
depthBias (shader axis, single-sourced in terrain_depth_bias.hglsl — NOT modeled here)
polygonMode (only a future DebugWireframe pipeline needs it)
fields.note: frontFace + cullMode + polygonOffsetEnable are repo-owned per-pipeline rows. The 3 shadow-caster pipelines (ShadowTerrain/ShadowStaticProp/ShadowMech) are DESCRIPTIVE (pipelineDescRegistered=false, not applyPipeline-routed) — they exist so polygonOffsetEnable is an authoritative fact (only ShadowStaticProp=true). Polygon offset factor/units stay dynamic. Active applyPipeline routing of shadow state = SHADOW-CASTER-APPLYPIPELINE-ROUTING-1 (later, gated).

gaps: explicit per-channel colorWriteMask (StaticPropDepth masks color via external glColorMask, not the desc)

registered_pipelines.renderPassCompat: sub-pass of StaticPropOpaque (runtime fetches Opaque desc; alpha = texture-array select + shader discard)

shaderVariantId.recording: RenderCore::recordPipelineVariantKey(MechOpaque, 'mech|'+shaderDefineKey(prefix)) in gos_mech_batcher at bindProgram; path-independent (GLSL==SPIR-V). Default runtime variant key = mech|MC2_OBJECT_ID_BUFFER=1;MC2_USE_VIEW_UNIFORMS=1 (both macros default-ON).

registered_pipelines.renderPassCompat: sub-pass (camera depth-prepass; color masked by caller glColorMask)

registered_pipelines.descriptive: SHADOW-CASTER-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row, NOT applyPipeline-routed. vertexLayout deferred (not modeled this slice).

SHADOW-CASTER-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row, NOT applyPipeline-routed. The ONLY shadow caster with polygon offset ON (factor/units 2.0/4.0 are dynamic/ImGui, not modeled). vertexLayout deferred.
SHADOW-CASTER-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row, NOT applyPipeline-routed. vertexLayout deferred.

TERRAIN-OVERLAY-DECAL-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row, NOT applyPipeline-routed (gosRenderer::drawTerrainOverlays sets state by hand). vertexLayout deferred (WorldOverlayVert 28B, not yet a VertexLayoutId).

TERRAIN-OVERLAY-DECAL-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row, NOT applyPipeline-routed (gosRenderer::drawDecals sets state by hand). FIRST AlphaBlend pipeline row — exercises the blend-factor axis. depthWrite=false (decals must not occlude). vertexLayout deferred.

WATER-ARMED-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: descriptive row for the ARMED water fast-path base only (gosRenderer::renderWaterFastPath, gos_terrain_water_fast.vert + gos_tex_vertex.frag). NOT applyPipeline-routed (state hand-set + save/restored). Legacy quad fallback + GPU-driven MDI sub-variant deliberately NOT modeled. Source-verified gameos_graphics.cpp:3275-3288. vertexLayout deferred.

depthState.note: depthWrite default-ON (OOB-FOG-WATER-DEPTH-1); MC2_WATER_NO_DEPTH_WRITE is a debug A/B gate only

cullState.note: CINEMATIC-WATER-CULL-1: flat overlay mesh, cull explicitly disabled

registered_pipelines.descriptive: VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: particle_billboard, alpha. DESCRIPTIVE (gos_particle_bridge.cpp). vertexLayout deferred (gl_VertexID, SSBO 14).
VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: particle_billboard, additive. BlendMode::Additive is COARSE — exact factors SRC_ALPHA/ONE recorded below are authoritative (gos_particle_bridge.cpp:1128).
VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: tube_ribbon, alpha. DESCRIPTIVE (gos_particle_bridge.cpp). vertexLayout deferred (SSBO 14/15/16 + IBO).

VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: tube_ribbon, additive. ★ exact factors ONE/ONE (gos_particle_bridge.cpp:767) — DIFFER from billboard/mesh SRC_ALPHA/ONE; BlendMode::Additive cannot encode the difference, these factors are authoritative.
VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: vfx_mesh, alpha. DESCRIPTIVE (gos_vfx_mesh_bridge.cpp). vertexLayout deferred (fixed VAO pos3+uv2, u16 EBO).
VFX-PIPELINE-REGISTRATION-1: vfx_mesh, additive. exact factors SRC_ALPHA/ONE (gos_vfx_mesh_bridge.cpp:311) — same as billboard, DIFFER from tube ONE/ONE.

excluded_draw_families.reason: set fixed-function state ad-hoc (not pipelineDescRegistered); no PipelineDesc row
excluded_draw_families.note: These must be onboarded to PipelineDesc/Registry before they can carry a PipelineKey.

pilot_family.why: single program, single fixed VAO (GpuMechVertex 48B), already pipelineDescRegistered=true, already in reflect.py SHADER_VARIANTS (mech.{vert,frag} default/objectid/viewuniforms), smallest variant set (OBJECT_ID x USE_VIEW_UNIFORMS = 4). Cleanest target for eventual PSO validation.
pilot_family.runner_up: StaticPropOpaque (registered + reflected, but up to 16 variants â€” larger surface)

answers.can_every_registered_pipeline_produce_a_: YES, partial â€” all 4 produce the authoritative core (depth/cull/blend-factor/attachment-mask/render-pass-compat) plus a finite-but-not-yet-id'd shaderVariantId.
answers.authoritative_vs_descriptive: AUTHORITATIVE: depthState, renderPassCompat, vertexLayout (VERTEXLAYOUT-AUTHORITY-1), materialLayout (binding/sampler/material ABI), blend factor, cull mode, attachment mask. PARTIAL: rasterState (frontFace + cullMode authoritative; polygonOffset/depthBias gap). DESCRIPTIVE: shaderVariantId, specializationParams, per-pipeline descriptor grouping. MISSING: blendEquation, colorWriteMask granularity, rasterState polygonOffset/depthBias/polygonMode.
answers.excluded_families: 9 ad-hoc raster passes + 2 SSBO/gl_VertexID-driven families (see excluded_draw_families).

exclusions: No Vulkan, no SPIR-V consumer, no shader edits, no makeShader change, no material M4 unify, no pipeline-cache impl, no RenderDevice.
